page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at the top; catchword-like word "eadem" set at the right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: urita perambulet, peregrinationis ergo, neque Romam neque Cantuariam, neque Compostellam, siue quocunque perambulare solet vulgus hominum.

Qua schedula cum istis articulis contentis in eadem (ut praefertur) per dictum dominum Ioannem perlecta, nos cum confratribus nostris praedictis, aliisque pluribus Doctoribus, et peritis super his communi cauimus, ac demum de consilio, & assensu eorundem, praefato domino Ioanni Oldcastello, dixImus tibi idem. Ecce domine Ioannes in hac schedula plura bona continentur, & satis Catholica, sed uos habetis terminum istum ad respondendum super aliis, errores et haereses sapientibus, quibus per contenta in hac schedula, non est plene responsum, & propterea uos oportet ad eadem, & fidem uestram atque assertiones in eadem schedula expressas circa

page.notes: Printed text is partly damaged and low-contrast; several words are doubtful, notably "dixImus tibi idem" and "communicauimus" (read as communi cauimus). Catchword "eadem" read at the foot right. Right edge contains a small marking that is not text.
